title: Design-Glanza Research Finding
description: The machine-checkable shape of one Research Finding (RF-NNN) record, per design-research/research-to-design.md and templates/research-finding.md. This schema documents the required shape for authoring/reviewing a finding; it is not itself invoked by any script in scripts/ (see design-research/README.md's disclosed limitation on automated RF-NNN referential-integrity checking).

id.description: Unique finding ID, per product-intelligence/traceability.md's sideways-reference model (same category as BR-NNN/EDGE-NNN/DEP-NNN).

source.description: The input or reference this finding was derived from (a BRD section, a named competitor, a domain standard, an existing product screen, etc.).

area.description: Which research area produced this finding. 'user' cites methodology/empathize.md's output rather than re-deriving it.

observation.description: The shallow, factual observation before interpretation (what was seen), per design-research/pattern-analysis.md's shallow-vs-deep distinction.

insight.description: The falsifiable claim about user behavior/need this evidence implies, per design-research/insight-model.md.

confidence.description: Confidence in the Insight itself — independent of priority.

priority.description: Per design-research/research-to-design.md's priority classification — independent of confidence.

design_principle.description: The generalized rule this insight implies, per design-research/research-to-design.md. Required once priority is CRITICAL or HIGH.

design_implication.description: What this finding should change or confirm about the design, stated concretely enough to check later.

ux_decision.description: The structural choice that applies the Design Principle, citing the artifact that records it (e.g. ux/screen-architecture.md).

ui_pattern.description: The concrete component/composition that realizes the UX Decision, citing the artifact that records it (e.g. ui/ui-rules.md, ui/components.md).

validation.description: How methodology/test.md's Test phase will check (or has checked) whether this finding's design implication actually worked.

anti_generic_check.description: Recorded only when this finding proposes a common/default pattern, per design-research/pattern-analysis.md's Anti-Generic Design challenge.

status.description: 'applied' requires ux_decision and/or ui_pattern to be non-empty for CRITICAL/HIGH priority (B16, config/quality-gates.md). 'deferred' requires a stated reason in design_implication.
